description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The hiring company is a boutique software consultancy. The Full Stack Engineer will maintain and enhance cloud-based applications, develop backend functionality, support frontend development, and contribute to production reliability using Python and/or Node.js, React, TypeScript, and AWS.
Full Stack Engineer building and maintaining cloud-based web applications, APIs, backend services, and React frontends

Responsibilities:
• Maintain and enhance existing cloud-based applications
• Troubleshoot software bugs, implement fixes, and support production services
• Develop backend functionality using Python and/or Node.js
• Support frontend development using React and TypeScript
• Collaborate with DevOps engineers on deployments using AWS infrastructure
• Build, maintain, and support APIs and web applications
• Identify technical issues and implement practical solutions to improve application reliability and functionality

Requirements:
• One to three or more years of relevant professional experience
• Professional experience with Python, TypeScript, Node.js, or React
• Experience building or maintaining APIs and web applications
• Familiarity with AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
• Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
• Must be a U.S. citizen and reside in the United States
